content: Hexagonal architecture. Domain innermost, application defines ports, infrastructure provides adapters. Layer order DOMAIN, APPLICATION, INFRASTRUCTURE, CONTROL. No cross-layer dependencies. Port flow outbound to inbound. Severity: every CU is CRITICAL unless the CU content downgrades it explicitly.

CU means Computational Unit. A CU content block carries REQUIREMENTS, COORDINATES, IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS and ACCEPTANCE. Each numbered step names an exact file path, carries a fenced code block when it changes a file, and ends with a Prove line naming the exact command. Do NOT touch lists what this CU must not modify. Stop when is the exit condition.

All edits live in one file so a single CU owns it.

def final_wave_label(waves: Sequence[WaveDef]) -> int:
    """Return the label of the last wave of a run (not the wave count)."""
    return waves[-1]["wave"]


def is_final_wave(wave: int, final_label: int) -> bool:
    """True only for the wave whose label is the last wave's label."""
    return wave == final_label


def lead_commit_instruction(wave: int, final_wave: int, feedback_dir: Path) -> str:
    """Build the lead's commit instruction for one wave, final or non-final."""
    if is_final_wave(wave, final_wave):
        return (
            "\n8. Read COMMIT_MESSAGE fields from all feedback files across all waves\n"
            "9. Consolidate into a single commit message\n"
            "10. Stage all changes and commit with the consolidated message\n"
        )
    return (
        "\n8. Prepare a COMMIT_MESSAGE for this wave in "
        + str(feedback_dir)
        + "/wave-"
        + str(wave)
        + "-commit.txt\n"
        + "9. Do NOT commit — the final wave lead will commit\n"
    )
```

"""Regression tests for bug-11: final-wave detection uses the last wave label."""
import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType
from typing import Sequence

import unittest

ROOT: Path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
TOOLS: Path = ROOT / ".LLMDD" / "tools"
RUNNER_PATH: Path = TOOLS / "run-waves.py"
_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("run_waves_tool", RUNNER_PATH)
if _SPEC is None or _SPEC.loader is None:
    raise RuntimeError("cannot load the wave runner module")
RUNNER: ModuleType = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_SPEC)
sys.modules["run_waves_tool"] = RUNNER
_SPEC.loader.exec_module(RUNNER)

DEFER: str = "Do NOT commit"
COMMIT: str = "Stage all changes and commit with the consolidated message"


class TestFinalWaveDetection(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_t1_table_driven_final_label(self) -> None:
        cases: Sequence[Sequence[int]] = ([1, 2, 3], [8], [7, 8], [1, 2, 8])
        labels: Sequence[int]
        for labels in cases:
            final: int = RUNNER.final_wave_label([{"wave": w} for w in labels])
            self.assertEqual(final, labels[-1])
            finals: list[int] = [w for w in labels if RUNNER.is_final_wave(w, final)]
            self.assertEqual(finals, [labels[-1]])

    def test_t2_dry_run_single_corrective_wave_commits(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            itr: Path = Path(tmp)
            itr.joinpath("cu-001.itr").write_text("step content\n", encoding="utf-8")
            waves: Path = itr / "waves.json"
            waves.write_text(
                json.dumps([{"wave": 8, "description": "corrective", "cus": ["cu-001"]}]),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            proc: subprocess.CompletedProcess[str] = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, str(RUNNER_PATH), "--itr", str(itr), "--app", "repo",
                 "--waves", str(waves), "--dry-run"],
                cwd=str(ROOT), capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
            )
        self.assertEqual(proc.returncode, 0, proc.stderr)
        self.assertIn(COMMIT, proc.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn(DEFER, proc.stdout)

    def test_t3_non_final_waves_still_defer(self) -> None:
        feedback: Path = Path("/tmp/no-such-feedback")
        non_final: str = RUNNER.lead_commit_instruction(1, 8, feedback)
        self.assertIn(DEFER, non_final)
        self.assertNotIn(COMMIT, non_final)
        final_msg: str = RUNNER.lead_commit_instruction(8, 8, feedback)
        self.assertIn(COMMIT, final_msg)
        self.assertNotIn(DEFER, final_msg)
```
